instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: Wealth management advisory serving 400+ high-net-worth families with holistic financial planning, tax optimization, and estate structuring. Blending in-person advisory with a client portal for portfolio tracking. Seeking to enhance client reporting with interactive scenario modeling tools. The company has mature core business processes but struggles with the tension between running the existing operation efficiently and carving out resources for innovation. We have pockets of digital maturity in specific teams while other areas rely heavily on manual workflows and spreadsheets.
answers.pastInitiatives: We have a mature innovation program with a dedicated R&D lab of 12 engineers, an annual innovation budget equivalent to 5% of revenue, and a structured stage-gate process for evaluating and funding new initiatives. In the past 3 years we have launched 4 new product lines that now contribute 18% of total revenue, including an AI-powered recommendation engine that has become our fastest-growing SKU.
answers.strategicGoals: Our core business is stable and cash-generative, but we see limited growth potential within our current market. We are actively exploring adjacent business models — potentially a marketplace, a subscription-based service layer, or a data monetization play built on the proprietary data we already collect. We are willing to incubate 2-3 experimental business lines with seed funding to test viability.
answers.teamSize: The technology organization is structured into product-aligned squads with a central platform team of 5 engineers enabling shared infrastructure. Innovation is driven by a '20% time' policy where all engineers can dedicate one day per sprint to self-directed projects, plus a quarterly internal pitch competition where winning ideas receive seed funding and 3 months of dedicated squad allocation.

input.changes_since_last: Supply chain disruptions affected 8 product lines. Inventory digitalization project launched. Margins under pressure.

opportunities.title: Develop Proprietary Data Marketplace Layer
opportunities.rationale: The proprietary data collected from high-net-worth clients is a significant, untapped asset. Moving beyond simple reporting to create structured datasets for external consumption or dedicated subscription services represents the highest growth leverage point and fully utilizes the 'bold' risk appetite.

first_actions: Establish an internal data governance committee (legal/compliance focus)
Define the MVP scope: starting with a limited, non-PII dataset for external subscription testing
Pilot API access using product squad infrastructure to validate usage patterns
execution_plan.success_metric: Minimum of 3 paid beta subscribers or strategic partnership interest within 6 months.
milestones: First functional API endpoint launched internally.
Initial pitch deck prepared for targeted external buyers.

opportunities.title: End-to-End Supply Chain and Margin Stabilization
opportunities.rationale: The current supply chain disruptions are pressuring margins across multiple lines. Digitizing the entire inventory flow, from procurement to final delivery, is critical for operational stabilization before major diversification initiatives can take hold.

first_actions: Map physical and digital workflows across the 8 affected product lines.
Implement cloud-based, real-time inventory tracking (IoT/RFID where feasible).
Integrate key vendor systems into a single master planning tool.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in average inventory holding costs by 15% within one fiscal quarter.
milestones: Selection and deployment of core ERP/SCM module.
Digital tracking successfully piloted across two high-volume product lines.

next_steps.action: Formalize a cross-functional 'Diversification Steering Committee' involving R&D leadership, senior strategy, and legal to manage scope creep across all incubation efforts.
Initiate the pilot program for digital inventory tracking using product-aligned squads, focusing on the highest margin losses first.
Define and fund a dedicated 'Innovation Readiness Buffer' (separate from the R&D budget) to handle immediate compliance costs related to new data streams.

key_weaknesses: Cultural inertia remains a barrier, particularly in adopting radically new operational processes (supply chain digitalization).
Difficulty integrating non-digital, historical manual workflows into modern data models.
Risk of strategic distraction due to managing 3+ parallel incubation tracks (marketplace, subscription, data play).

improvements: Significant increase in dedicated innovation budget commitment (17% -> 20%).
Established robust structural governance for innovation via the R&D lab and '20% time' policy.
Operational digitalization has officially launched with the Inventory Project.
persistent_gaps: Lack of standardized, centralized data governance across all business units to support monetization efforts.
Slow adoption cycle for process changes originating from technology teams into core operational roles.
achieved_milestones: Successful funding and staffing of the dedicated R&D lab structure.
Clear definition of product-aligned squad ownership, improving accountability.

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: Significant increase in structural capability, resource allocation (budget), and formalized innovation processes. The company has transitioned from merely 'formal' to highly capable ('advanced-aspirational'), greatly increasing its capacity for aggressive diversification and bolder risk taking.
